board.name: Gideon
board.bio: Dad. Builder. Turns “can we make this?” into “let’s give it a try.” As a board member and founding investor, Gideon supports the children with investment, technical resources and mentorship while they lead their own projects and businesses.

leadership.name: Kaylie
leadership.bio: Big ideas start with “what if?” Kaylie brings imagination, curiosity and creative possibilities to the projects we make together.

leadership.name: Owen
leadership.bio: Designing the gameplay, dreaming up challenges and helping turn new ideas into games we can play together.

leadership.name: Bella
leadership.bio: If there’s a glitch, Bella will find it. If there isn’t, give her five minutes. In charge of epic play-tests, impossible button combos and telling Owen, “I broke it again.”
leadership.footer: BUGS FEAR HER. OWEN TAKES NOTES.

leadership.name: Gideon
leadership.bio: Dad. Builder. Supports our young leaders with the engineering and technical resources to bring their ideas to life.

open_roles.title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
open_roles.tagline: Anyone want to step up to be the CEO?
open_roles.description: Bring your big idea, gather a crew and lead a project. We can have more than one CEO: different projects need different captains!

open_roles.title: Chief Buzz Maker
open_roles.description: Dream up posters, catchy messages and fun ways to tell the world what we’re making. Big imagination beats a big follower count.

open_roles.title: Chief Story Sharer
open_roles.tagline: Be the voice of our adventures.
open_roles.description: Share team news, celebrate little wins and help everyone follow what we’re dreaming up next.

open_roles.title: Chief Game Editor
open_roles.tagline: One more go? That’s your department.
open_roles.description: Play-test our games, spot the tricky bits and suggest better rules, levels and challenges. Team up with Owen to make every round more fun.

open_roles.title: Chief News Editor
open_roles.description: Check the facts, polish the words and help choose stories that make kids say “wait, really?” Keep our newsroom thoughtful, kind and full of discoveries.

open_roles.title: Book Explorer
open_roles.description: Explore new books, tell us what made you laugh or wonder, and help choose the next adventures for our bookshelf.

open_roles.title: Curiosity Reporter
open_roles.description: Everyone is welcome to share a discovery. Send a story and its source; after review, published posts get an author credit and date. Let’s learn from each other!
